WITH matched_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.instownpct,
    t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg_ownership
  FROM matched_data
),
order_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(instownpct) as avg_by_type
  FROM matched_data
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    md.instownpct,
    md.ordertypedist,
    ots.avg_by_type,
    oa.overall_avg_ownership
  FROM matched_data md
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  LEFT JOIN order_type_stats ots ON md.ordertypedist = ots.ordertypedist
  WHERE md.instownpct > oa.overall_avg_ownership
)
SELECT 
  AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership,
  AVG(instownpct / avg_by_type) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(instownpct - overall_avg_ownership) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_data
